summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The candidate adds no production change, and both regression cases already pass on its exact parent/base. Independent use of the real checkpoint config confirms that current AUTO dispatch selects SGLang's native DeepseekV4ForCausalLM before the Hugging Face fallback. The original end-to-end two-GPU NVIDIA serving scenario remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate e0e0ef0817fe8ead8ee19803501c7d7e09c49691, its native-dispatch regression and unknown-architecture fallback test both passed (2 passed).

The candidate test file also passed unchanged on exact base/parent 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 (2 passed), proving the candidate is test-only hardening rather than a failing-before/passing-after fix.

tests.what_was_measured: The real config loaded as _DeepseekV4ConfigAlias and resolved to sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4.DeepseekV4ForCausalLM under AUTO. Direct AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config reproduced the reported ValueError, locating the observed exception at the HF-only boundary rather than current native AUTO dispatch.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual ModelConfig AUTO resolved the native DeepSeek V4 class. Explicit TRANSFORMERS mode selected the generic TransformersMoEForCausalLM wrapper, a separate path not exercised by the reported default command.

gpu_execution_evidence: No GPU execution was used as proof. Configuration parsing and class dispatch occur before GPU execution, and the available single AMD gfx950 cannot qualify the reported two-GPU NVIDIA Blackwell environment.
remaining_counterexamples: No end-to-end launch of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 was performed, so a later startup failure after successful native dispatch is not excluded.
The reported TP=2 NVIDIA B200/RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, CUDA 13.3, and flashinfer_mxfp4 path was not available and remains unverified.
The full checkpoint weights and semantic generation output were not tested.

A direct Hugging Face AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config call with SGLang's alias still raises the exact reported ValueError; current default AUTO routing avoids that boundary rather than registering the alias with Hugging Face AutoModel.
remaining_limitations: Architecture mismatch: one AMD gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 was available instead of two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with CUDA 13.3.
No model weights, TP=2 execution, FlashInfer MXFP4 execution, full server startup, numerical generation reference, or NVIDIA compiler/ISA validation.
The candidate changes no native or production source, so native rebuild validation was not applicable.
